blocks.text: Gas ki naqal (gas transport) tanaffus ka lazmi hissa hai: oxygen phephron se tamam tissues tak le jai jati hai aur isi waqt carbon dioxide tissues se phephron tak.

Alveoli mein oxygen ka juzvi dabao (partial pressure) use alveoli ke paar pulmonary capillaries mein diffuse hone deta hai. Khoon ke andar thori si oxygen plasma mein hal hoti hai, jo zyada se zyada sirf qareeb 3 mL O2 fi litre hal kar sakta hai; phir bhi poora khoon qareeb 200 mL O2 fi litre le jata hai. Wajah yeh hai ke zyada tar oxygen plasma mein hal nahin balke red blood cells (RBCs) ke andar haemoglobin ke molecules se bandhi hoti hai.

Samundar ki satah par alveoli mein oxygen ka juzvi dabao taqreeban 105 mm Hg hai, jo fiza se kam hai, aur is dabao par RBCs ka qareeb 97% haemoglobin oxygen se mil kar oxyhaemoglobin banta hai, jis ka rang chamakdar surkh, tamatar ke ras jaisa hai. Jab khoon capillaries se guzarta hai to kuch oxyhaemoglobin oxygen chhor kar gehra surkh deoxyhaemoglobin ban jata hai. Jab khoon veins mein tissues se nikalta hai to us ka oxygen ka juzvi dabao kam (40 mm Hg) hota hai aur us ka 75% haemoglobin ab bhi oxyhaemoglobin ke taur par sair hai. To 22% (97% manfi 75%) oxyhaemoglobin ne apni oxygen tissues ko di hai, aur 78% khoon mein zakheere (reserve) ke taur par baqi hai. Yeh bara zakheera khoon ko warzish aur aaram dono mein jism ki oxygen ki zaroorat poori karne ke qabil banata hai.

blocks.title: Naliyan surkh aur neeli kyun banai jati hain
blocks.text: Oxyhaemoglobin chamakdar surkh aur deoxyhaemoglobin gehra surkh hai, magar deoxyhaemoglobin tissues ko neela-pan deta hai. In rang ki tabdeeliyon ki wajah se oxygen wala khoon le jane wali naliyan hamesha surkh aur oxygen se khali khoon wali neeli dikhai jati hain. Oxygen ka zakheera yeh bhi yaqeeni banata hai ke saans rukne ya dil ke pump band hone par chaar se paanch minute tak zindagi qaim rakhne ke liye khoon mein kafi oxygen ho.
Oxygen ki naqal par asar dalne wale awamil

Warzish ke dauran pathe capillary ke khoon se zyada oxygen lete hain, jo venous khoon mein oxygen ka juzvi dabao 20 mm Hg tak gira deta hai; tab haemoglobin ki sairi (saturation) 75% se 35% par aa jati hai. Chunke arterial khoon mein ab bhi 97% oxyhaemoglobin hai, ab utari (unload) gai oxygen ki miqdar aaram ke 22% ke bajaye 62% (97% manfi 35%) hai. Tissues ki bani CO2 khoon ka pH girati hai, aur gira hua pH haemoglobin ki oxygen se kashish (affinity) kam karta hai, to woh oxygen zyada asani se chhorta hai; pH ka haemoglobin ki affinity par yeh asar Bohr effect hai. Barhta darja-hararat bhi aisa hi asar rakhta hai, is liye warzish mein, jab skeletal muscles zyada garmi banate hain, haemoglobin apni oxygen ka zyada hissa utarta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen pattiyan jo haemoglobin ki oxygen se sairi (saturation) dikhati hain: arterial khoon, PO2 105 mm Hg par 97%; aaram mein venous khoon, PO2 40 mm Hg par 75% (22% utri); warzish mein venous khoon, PO2 20 mm Hg par 35% (62% utri). Neeche 0 se 100% ka paimana hai.
blocks.caption: Mukhtalif PO2 par haemoglobin ki oxygen se sairi (matn ke aadad se asal chart; kitab mein yahan koi figure nahin).

blocks.text: Khoon ki capillaries tissues ko oxygen deti aur un se carbon dioxide hatati hain. CO2 ka juzvi dabao khoon se zyada tissues mein hai, to carbon dioxide khoon mein dakhil hoti hai; phephron mein amal ulat jata hai, jahan CO2 ka juzvi dabao khoon se kam alveoli mein hai. Khoon carbon dioxide ko tissues se phephron tak teen tareeqon se le jata hai.

items: Bicarbonate ions ke taur par (qareeb 72%): CO2 RBCs mein dakhil ho kar enzyme carbonic anhydrase ki maujoodgi mein pani se mil kar carbonic acid (H2CO3) banati hai. Carbonic acid hydrogen ions (H+) aur bicarbonate ions (HCO3-) mein tootti hai. Hydrogen ion asani se oxyhaemoglobin se jurta hai, jis ki oxygen tissue ko chhor di jati hai, jab ke bicarbonate ions RBCs se plasma mein nikal jate hain. Un ki harkat ek transporter se asaan hoti hai jo har bicarbonate ion ke badle ek chloride ion (Cl-) deta hai, yani chloride shift ya Hamburger phenomenon.
Carboxyhaemoglobin ke taur par (qareeb 20%): jab CO2 ka juzvi dabao tissues se zyada khoon mein ho to CO2 haemoglobin ki globin chains se mil kar carboxyhaemoglobin banati hai.
Plasma mein hal CO2 ke taur par (qareeb 8%): jab CO2 khoon mein aati hai to thori si plasma ke pani mein hal ho jati hai.

blocks.text: Khoon CO2 ko in teen shaklon mein phephron tak le jata hai. Alveolar hawa mein CO2 ka kam juzvi dabao H2CO3 ko wapas H2O aur CO2 mein badalta hai, aur CO2 khoon se alveoli mein diffuse ho kar agli saans ke saath jism se nikal jati hai.

blocks.title: Acid-base tawazun, aur O2 aur CO2 muqabla kyun nahin karte
blocks.text: Carbonic acid ka banna khoon ka acid-base tawazun qaim rakhne mein aham hai, kyunke bicarbonate khoon ke plasma ka bara buffer hai. CO2 haemoglobin ke protein hisse se bandhti hai jab ke O2 haem ke iron se, is liye dono jurne ke liye muqabla nahin karte.

blocks.alt: Do hisse. Tissue wala sira: tissue cells ki carbon dioxide capillary ki deewar paar karti hai; kuch plasma mein ghulti hai, kuch red blood cells mein ja kar haemoglobin se jurti hai, aur kuch pani se mil kar (carbonic anhydrase) carbonic acid banati hai jo hydrogen ions (Hb se jurte hain) aur bicarbonate ions deta hai; bicarbonate RBC se nikalta hai aur chloride andar aata hai. Alveoli wala sira: yahi reactions ulti chalti hain aur carbon dioxide alveoli mein nikal jati hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tissue par CO2 ke teen raste: plasma mein ghulna (qareeb 8%), haemoglobin se jurna (qareeb 20%) aur bicarbonate banna (qareeb 72%). HCO3- ke bahar jane par barabari ke liye Cl- andar aata hai; ise chloride shift kehte hain. Phephron mein sab ulta hota hai aur CO2 saans ke saath nikal jati hai.

blocks.title: Carbon monoxide zehr-khurani (poisoning)
blocks.text: Lakri, petrol, propane ya qudrati gas jaise eendhan ka na-mukammal jalna CO gas banata hai; band kamron mein gas heater raat bhar jalte rahen to yeh jama ho jati hai. Saans se li gai CO oxygen se kahin zyada kashish se haemoglobin se bandhti hai, jo oxygen le jane ke liye dastiyab haemoglobin kam karti aur tissues mein hypoxia (oxygen ki mehroomi) paida karti hai. Alamat mein sar dard, chakkar, kamzori, matli, uljhan, saans ki tangi, seene mein dard aur be-hoshi shamil ho sakti hain; shadeed sooraton mein mustaqil dimaghi nuqsan aur maut bhi.

blocks.prompt: Ek daurne wale ke kaam karte taang ke pathe garam hain aur bohat CO2 bana rahe hain. Matn ke aadad se samjhayein ke khoon wahan aaram ke muqable kitni zyada oxygen utarta hai, aur kyun.
blocks.explanation: Aaram mein oxygen ka venous juzvi dabao 40 mm Hg hai, haemoglobin 75% sair rehta hai aur sirf 22% utarta hai. Warzish mein pathe venous juzvi dabao 20 mm Hg tak kheench lete hain, sairi 35% par girti hai aur 62% utarta hai, qareeb teen guna. Zaid CO2 pH girati hai aur garmi darja-hararat barhati hai, aur dono haemoglobin ki oxygen se kashish kam karte hain (Bohr effect), to oxygen wahan zyada asani se chhoot'ti hai jahan us ki zaroorat hai.

items: Oxygen: plasma qareeb 3 mL fi litre hal karta hai, poora khoon qareeb 200 mL le jata hai kyunke haemoglobin use bandhta hai; arterial khoon mein 97% sair (105 mm Hg), aaram ke venous khoon mein 75% (40 mm Hg), to 22% utri aur 78% zakheera; warzish mein 35% (20 mm Hg) aur 62% utri. Kam pH (Bohr effect) aur garmi haemoglobin se zyada chhurwati hain.

Carbon dioxide: 72% bicarbonate ke taur par carbonic anhydrase se chloride shift ke saath, 20% globin chains par carboxyhaemoglobin, 8% hal; phephron mein ulat. Bicarbonate plasma ko buffer karta hai; CO2 aur O2 haemoglobin ke alag hisson se bandhte hain. Carbon monoxide oxygen ko peeche chhor kar hypoxia karti hai.
